messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P0 026-03-15T02:08:30Z  TLS handshake failures affecting hosted inference in us-east-1. Auto-detector: TLS handshake error rate spike + client-side timeouts. Pager: https://pd.example/incident/RED-421. Initial impact estimate: ~18-25% TLS handshakes failing, several customer errors surfaced.

alice: Oncall here, taking lead. Starting blast-radius triage and mitigation. Who can check cert-rotation and network path stats?

bob: I'm in. Will watch peering routes, transit gateway counters, and ICMP frag-needed events.

alice: Deploy logs show cert-rotation job kicked off at 02:07:58Z. Status: 7/11 LBs succeeded, 4/11 timed out during reload. Looks like a staggered rollout with partial completion.

carla: I can do the notes and prepare for handoff at 03:00 if needed. Joining channel.

dan: Customer ops: multiple support tickets from enterprise accounts with TLS errors and timeouts beginning ~02:12Z. Flagging corp-cust-42 and platform-cust-7.

alice: Quick probe with curl against an affected VIP returns an OpenSSL TLS error: 

```
$ curl -v https://inference.api.example/health
* Rebuilt URL to: https://inference.api.example/health/
*   Trying 10.6.4.88:443...
* Connected to inference.api.example (10.6.4.88) port 443 (#0)
* TLS 1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Client hello (1):
* error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert internal error
* Closing connection 0
curl: (35) error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert internal error
```

alice: LB Envoy logs show repeated messages: `tls: handshake error: remote error: handshake failure` and occasionally `certificate chain validation error`. Pasting snippets: 

```
[2026-03-15T02:10:05Z] envoy error tls: handshake failure, client_ip=10.9.1.7, sni=inference.api.example
[2026-03-15T02:10:06Z] envoy error tls: certificate mismatch with presented chain
[2026-03-15T02:10:06Z] envoy warn  tls: client hello truncated
```

bob: Network telemetry shows ICMP Frag Needed (Type 3 Code 4) originating from the peer VPC interface at 02:09:12Z. Snippet of tcpdump: 

```
02:09:12.987654 IP 10.1.2.11 > 192.168.5.2: ICMP 3/4 frag needed and DF set, mtu 1420
02:09:12.987900 IP 10.1.2.11 > 192.168.5.2: TCP 0 > 443: Flags [S], seq 0, win 65535
02:09:12.988150 IP 10.1.2.11 > 192.168.5.2: TCP 0 > 443: Flags [S], retransmission
```

bob: Two working hypotheses: (A) partial cert rotation resulted in certificate chain/SNI mismatches for some LB nodes; (B) path MTU blackhole caused TLS ClientHello fragments or ServerHello responses to be dropped resulting in handshake aborts. Both could be true concurrently.

alice: Immediate plan: 1) pause further cert-rotation; 2) roll back to previous cert bundle on the failing LB nodes (those 4/11); 3) implement MTU workaround (lower MTU to 1400 on transit interface) while we investigate PMTU. Executing 1 & 2 now.

carla: I'll capture the timeline and collect log pointers.

alice: Rolled back certs on lb-cluster-7 nodes (n5,n6,n7,n8) at 02:21:40Z. Post-rollback, that cluster's per-node handshake failures dropped notably. `openssl s_client` against a rolled-back node shows successful TLS handshake: 

```
$ openssl s_client -connect 10.6.4.89:443 -servername inference.api.example
CONNECTED(00000003)
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=inference.api.example
 1 s:/CN=redwood-root
---
SSL-Session:
    Protocol  : TLSv1.3
    Cipher    : TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
---
```

alice: Metrics: node set failure rate fell from ~30% -> 2% within 60s after rollback. Aggregate failure rate fell from ~22% -> ~4% but residual failures remained.

bob: Applied MTU workaround on transit-gw at 02:33:15Z (forced MTU 1400). Subsequent tcpdump shows ICMP frag-needed cease and TLS handshakes complete end-to-end. Sample after fix: 

```
02:34:22.100 IP 10.1.2.11.49152 > 192.168.5.2.443: Flags [S]
02:34:22.110 IP 192.168.5.2.443 > 10.1.2.11.49152: Flags [S.]
02:34:22.111 IP 10.1.2.11.49152 > 192.168.5.2.443: Flags [.] 
02:34:22.140 TLS ClientHello ...
02:34:22.220 TLS ServerHello ... cipher TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256
```

alice: System-wide handshake failures dropped from ~20% -> ~1.1% within 10 minutes post-MTU change. Customer retries mostly successful. :white_check_mark:

eve: Customer-impact report: ~1.1k failed requests observed during the incident window; the majority were transient and retried successfully. No customer data corruption reported. Notifying top impacted customers now.

carla: Recording evidence and timeline for RCA: 
- Evidence collected: envoy logs (per-LB), full tcpdumps from affected path, cert-rotation job logs, deploy pipeline traces, kube events.
- Timeline (compiled): cert-rotation start 02:07:58Z -> partial node update completed 02:08:40Z -> handshake error spike 02:09:10Z -> ICMP frag-needed observed 02:09:12Z -> rollback start 02:21:40Z -> MTU workaround 02:33:15Z -> recovery 02:34:22Z.

carla: Hypothesis ranking after mitigation: 1) Primary: simultaneous partial cert-rotation (mixed certs) exposing SNI/chain mismatches, exacerbated by PMTU blackhole causing packet loss of TLS handshake messages. 2) Secondary: client-side TLS stack sensitivity to fragmented ClientHello leading to more failures in some client versions. 3) Low confidence: transient route-programming flap on peering.

dan: For full RCA we need pcaps for one affected AZ and one unaffected AZ, full deploy logs including cert bundle checksums and kube rollout events, and transit-gw MTU history from neteng. I will own pcap collection.

alice: Ownerships assigned: pcaps -> dan; cert-deploy logs and artifact checksums -> alice; timeline & evidence aggregation -> carla; customer comms -> eve; postmortem write -> carla + alice.

carla: Post-incident fixes proposed: 
- Add preflight TLS validation step to cert-rotation job: perform end-to-end handshake check on all LB nodes before marking success.
- Add PMTU/fragmentation monitoring and alerting on ICMP frag-needed spikes and long-stalled small-packet retransmits.
- Change rollout automation to abort & auto-rollback if TLS handshake-failure rate > 5% in a 2-minute window.
- Add test harness for fragmented TLS handshake scenarios to catch client sensitivities.

alice: I'll draft an exec summary and link to the full RCA doc when ready.

inc-bot: Incident RESOLVED 1999999488. Duration ~0h 8m 0s. Postmortem requested.

carla: Placing meeting notes and links to collected evidence in /confluence/incidents/RED-421 (will provide final link once document is published). Thanks all for quick response. :pray:
